name.ja: Bトレインショーティー 新幹線N700A・Bセット
name.en: B Train Shorty Shinkansen N700A/B Set

description.ja: • ベースはN700系。非常時のブレーキ性能の向上、運行ダイヤの乱れを自動修復する定速走行装置など最新の鉄道技術を結集し、2013年２月より営業運転開始。
description.en: • The base is N700 series. It brings together the latest railway technology, including improved braking performance in emergencies and a constant-speed running device that automatically repairs disruptions to the train schedule, and will begin commercial operation in 20132.

description.ja: • 先頭車16号車（784形1000番台）と中間車５号車（785形1300番台）の２両セット。
description.en: • A two-car set with the lead car No. 16 (784 type 1000 series) and the middle car No. 5 (785 type 1300 series).

description.ja: • 中間車には印象的なロゴマークを再現。
description.en: • An impressive logo mark is reproduced on the intermediate car.

description.ja: • 中間車は付属パーツで15号車（787形1500番台）に作り分けが可能。
description.en: • The intermediate car can be made into car No. 15 (787 type 1500 series) using the included parts.
